description: This file defines a NotificationService class intended for FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) integration within a Flutter app. It provides methods for requesting notification permissions, obtaining a messaging token, and handling foreground messages using a broadcast stream. Currently, the class functions as a scaffold with placeholder implementations, awaiting Firebase configuration.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: A scaffolded notification service for handling foreground messages and token retrieval in a Flutter app, initially not implementing full functionality.

methods.name: onForegroundMessage
methods.description: Returns a stream of foreground notification messages as a broadcast stream.

methods.name: requestPermissionIfNeeded
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to request notification permissions when necessary.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Placeholder method to obtain FCM token; currently returns null.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the foreground messages stream to release resources.
